question: Did the data-analytics tool reduce budget overruns on our audit engagements?

decision_rule.metric: effect of analytics_tool on the budget overrun (actual_hours / budget_hours - 1)

analysis: Audit quality memo FY2025: we compared the overrun (actual_hours / budget_hours - 1) of engagements that used the analytics tool with those that did not. Tool engagements ran 2.8 points lower (p < 0.001, n = 900). We plan to make the tool mandatory.

column_notes.actual_hours: hours charged to the engagement code at sign-off
column_notes.budget_hours: hours approved at the planning stage
column_notes.analytics_tool: 1 = the team used the data-analytics tool for journal-entry testing
column_notes.client_revenue_musd: client annual revenue, millions of USD
